name: Clean Cut Mono
tagline: Agentchengfeng/chengfeng-videocut-skills: the talking take cut clean (fillers, repeats, restarts out), one line of subtitle per phrase, black-and-white callouts, zoom off — doing nothing is often right.

motion.direction: chengfeng-cut + chengfeng-visual. The speaker stays full frame the whole time; the cut is the edit (turn on Clean cut). Subtitles: one line per screen, a new screen at every comma or full stop, proper nouns spelled right. Overlays are rare and plain: a black-and-white full-screen statement (white field, black type) only where the idea needs it, a green (`ter`) callout on the one word that matters. No zoom (at most 1.6× once, if ever). Doing nothing is often the right call: fewer than one element every 8 s.
